paths.description: Paths to analyze with PHP Insights, comma-separated. Defaults to `app`.

config-path.description: Path to a custom PHP Insights configuration file. Leave empty to let PHP Insights auto-detect `phpinsights.json` (or `config/insights.php` in Laravel apps) at the repository root, or fall back to its own defaults otherwise.

dirty.description: Only analyze files with uncommitted git changes (staged, unstaged, or untracked).

wip.description: Only analyze files changed on the current pull request (relative to its base branch).

wip-base-ref.description: Base branch/ref to diff against when `wip` is enabled. Defaults to `GITHUB_BASE_REF`, which GitHub Actions sets automatically on `pull_request` events.

name.description: Name reported by reviewdog to identify this check.

reporter.description: Reporter of reviewdog command [github-pr-check,github-check,github-pr-review]. Defaults to the reporter resolved by setup-reviewdog for this run's context (github-pr-check on pull requests, github-check otherwise).

fail-level.description: Exit code for reviewdog if it finds at least the specified level of diagnostic [none,any,info,warning,error].
